主要内容: On June 5, 2017, the District Court issued Findings of Fact and Conclusions of Law and entered Judgment ordering DISH Network L.L.C. to pay an aggregate amount of $280 million to Plaintiffs. The District Court also issued a Permanent Injunction against DISH Network L.L.C. that imposes certain ongoing compliance requirements on DISH Network L.L.C., which include, among other things: (i) the retention of a telemarketing-compliance expert to prepare a plan to ensure that DISH Network L.L.C. meets all legal obligations under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act and related regulations.
